entities.name: Robert Reid, 1st Earl Loreburn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Threshie Reid, 1st Earl Loreburn, was a British lawyer, judge and Liberal politician. A supporter of progressive social legislation, he served as Lord High Chancellor of Great Britain between 1905 and 1912.
